name: Allow s3:GetObject on * with an explicit Deny on the same action/resource (deny suppresses)
note: An Allow and a conflicting explicit Deny cover the same action and resource. AWS resolves this to Deny, so there is no effective object-read capability.
rationale: IAM policy evaluation applies explicit-Deny precedence: an explicit Deny always overrides any Allow. Here s3:GetObject on * is both allowed and explicitly denied, so the effective result is deny. The broad object-read (DATA-EXFIL) capability the Allow would otherwise grant is fully suppressed and MUST NOT be reported as an exfiltration capability. Ref: AWS IAM policy evaluation logic, 'Determining whether a request is allowed or denied' (explicit Deny wins).
